description: Add more self-hosted projects to data/projects.ts covering all existing categories and expanding the directory from 6 to at least 18 projects. Also add corresponding use cases.
steps: Add to the 'media' category: Jellyfin (media server, alternative to Plex), Nextcloud (file sync/share, alternative to Google Drive/Dropbox), Photoprism (AI-powered photo management).
Add to the 'monitoring' category: Grafana (dashboards and observability), Netdata (real-time monitoring), Prometheus (metrics collection and alerting).
Add to the 'security' category: Authentik (identity provider/SSO), Crowdsec (collaborative security), Wireguard-easy (VPN management UI).
Add to the 'data-tools' category: n8n (workflow automation, alternative to Zapier), Metabase (business intelligence/analytics), Appwrite (backend-as-a-service).
Add to the 'productivity' category: Outline (team wiki/docs, alternative to Notion), Vikunja (task management, alternative to Todoist), Bookstack (documentation platform).
Add to the 'ai' category: Ollama (local LLM runner), LocalAI (OpenAI-compatible local API), Langfuse (LLM observability/tracing).

Each new project must follow the exact same Project type structure in data/projects.ts: slug, name, iconUrl (from cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/svg/), categorySlug, category, tags, stack, license, deploy method, requirements, score (research-based), links (source, docs, demo if available), bilingual summary, notes, deployGuide (overview, steps array, backup), and deploySnippets (dockerCompose, setupScript).

Add new use cases to the useCases array: 'google-drive' (Nextcloud), 'plex' (Jellyfin), 'zapier' (n8n), 'notion' (Outline), 'chatgpt' (Open WebUI + Ollama), update existing use cases with new projectSlugs where relevant (e.g., add Photoprism to google-photos alternative).
Ensure all icon URLs are valid by using the homarr-labs/dashboard-icons repository pattern: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/svg/{name}.svg
acceptance_criteria: data/projects.ts contains at least 18 projects total (12+ new ones added)
Each category has at least 3 projects
All new projects have complete bilingual (vi/en) content for summary, notes, and deployGuide
All new projects have valid dockerCompose and setupScript snippets
useCases array is expanded with new alternatives covering the new projects
pnpm build succeeds with all new data (no type errors, all generateStaticParams work)
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm it succeeds (all static pages generate correctly)
Run pnpm lint and confirm no type errors
